grammar.title: 动词不定式(To do)
lines: To + do 的构成 不定式 的否定 句形成分
want to do 想去做什么 He wanted to buy a new car. 他本想买一辆新车。
want sb. to do 想要某人做什么 I want him to move his car. 我想让他移一下他的车。
tell sb. to do 告诉某人做什么 Tell him to go back right now.告诉他快点回来。
ask sb. to do 要求某人做什么 I asked Carol to help me with the assignment.我请卡罗尔帮我做作业。
don’t want sb. to do I don’t want him to worry about me. 我不想让他担心。
tell sb. not to do Tell him not to come back . 跟他说不要回来了。
ask sb. not to do I asked him not to smoke in the house. 我请他不要在屋内吸烟。
主 + 谓 + 宾 He wants to buy a new car .
主 + 谓 + 宾 + 宾补 I want him to move his car .

sentences.title: 动词不定式练习
lines: To Do 不定式的变化
carry 指从一个地方到另一个地方携带或运输物品 You must carry ID at all times. 你必须随身携带身份证件。
fetch 指去某个地方取回某物，并带回原处 He went to fetch some books.他去取来了一些书。
bring 指将某物从别处带到说话人所在的地方 All you need to bring are sheets. 你需要带的就是床单。
take 指将某物从说话人所在的地方带到别处，或者进行某种行为或活动 Take any necessary actions. / Take whatever action is needed . 采取任何必要的行动。
Don't do! 直接命令 (Direct) 祈使句
I told him not to do. 间接转述(Indirect) 动词不定式
肯定句 否定句
I want you to carry it. I don’t want you to hurt yourself.
He wants you to correct it. She doesn’t want him to slip.
He wants us to listen to it. Tell him not to fall. 动词不定式的否定形式
He wants me to describe it. Tell him not to miss it. Tell + someone + not + to do something
Warn him: "Warn him not to slip on the ice." (警告他不要在冰上滑倒。)
Remind him: "Remind him not to trip over the wires." (提醒他不要被电线绊倒。)
Advice: "Advise him against falling." (建议他别摔了 —— 虽然这种说法比较少见，但在正式文书里很有用。)

expand.title: 口语中常见的缩写（代表生活中使用频率高）
lines: 简单但地道的口语
口语缩写 书面原型 示例
wanna 想要... want to I want to / wanna have a big house in Beijing.
gonna 要去... going to I'm going to / gonna go today.
gotta 不得不... have got to I have got to / gotta go now.
kinda 有点... kind of She's kind of / kinda funny.
outta 离开(从...出来) out of I'm out of / outta here.
gimme 给我... give me Give me / Gimme some food!
watcha 你在... what are you What are you / Watcha thinking?
thx 谢谢 thanks Thanks / Thx for the information.
